scope: Jesus has six distinct body pictures; Look Unto Me has five.

placements.title: Meet the risen Savior
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of Christ among the people at Bountiful. Read the account of His invitation to come forward, and notice how each person is invited to witness for themselves.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a pale blue robe addressing people gathered at Bountiful

placements.title: Notice His pattern of prayer
placements.description: This devotional illustration accompanies Luke’s account of Jesus withdrawing to pray. Consider how making room for prayer could shape a day of following Him.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a green robe praying among olive trees

placements.title: Make room for children
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of Christ welcoming children. Mark records His insistence that they be allowed to come to Him. Read the encounter and consider whose voice might need more room in your own conversations.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a petrol-teal robe listening warmly to children in a village courtyard

placements.title: Bring fear into the conversation
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of the storm on the Sea of Galilee. Read what the disciples ask and how Jesus responds. This account invites study of His identity; it does not set a timetable for relief from every trial.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a plum robe standing with disciples in a boat on a stormy lake

placements.title: Keep the revelation beside its setting
placements.description: An illustrative historical writing desk, not a surviving artifact from Harmony. As you study the setting, distinguish the historical introduction from the words of the revelation itself.
placements.alt: A quill, books and writing papers on a wooden historical study desk

placements.title: Turn attention toward Christ
placements.description: A devotional image of Jesus praying. Read the invitation to look to Him in the surrounding sequence of encouragement, faithful action and remembrance.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ praying quietly in an olive grove

placements.title: Let an honest question remain visible
placements.description: A contemporary study illustration. You can write what is uncertain, then return to the passage without pretending the question has disappeared.
placements.alt: A woman reading scripture beside a notebook at a quiet table

placements.title: Talk about what you are learning
placements.description: A contemporary family study scene. Use the invitation to talk of Christ as a starting point for a conversation in which each person can describe what they noticed.
placements.alt: Family members reading and discussing scripture around a table

placements.title: Let study lead to something good
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of practical help. As you return to the week’s readings, choose one good action that fits your circumstances and another person’s needs.
placements.alt: Neighbors offering a meal and practical help at a doorway
